description: This file defines the Perl package Coocook::Schema::ResultSet::BlacklistUsername, which extends a ResultSet class and provides methods for managing blacklisted usernames, including adding usernames and checking if a username is okay.

classes.name: Coocook::Schema::ResultSet::BlacklistUsername
classes.description: A Perl class representing a ResultSet for blacklisted usernames, providing methods to add usernames to the blacklist and verify if a username is acceptable.

methods.name: add_username
methods.description: Adds a username to the blacklist with optional additional column data.

methods.name: is_username_ok
methods.description: Checks if a username is not blacklisted and is acceptable.
